headline: Elon Musk says SpaceX's Grok Bot will now choose among other companies' AI models, including Anthropic's Claude.
score_reason: Pool 6, lowered 1: the announcement was on Tuesday 6 Oct, before 7 Oct (stale).
importance_line: It means Grok Bot users may get answers from other companies' models, but the only source is Musk's social-media post and it does not explain how each choice is made.
summary: Gizmodo reports that Elon Musk, chief executive of SpaceX, said on Tuesday, 6 Oct 2026, that the Grok Bot agent service, SpaceX's AI assistant service, will now pick the best model for each request, including Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, the Midjourney image maker and the Suno audio maker. Gizmodo's own reading is that SpaceX could become an infrastructure provider for other AI companies, renting out computing, rather than competing only on top models.
notes: Full article read. Gizmodo's infrastructure reading is its own analysis and is labelled as such.
